product.name: LACK
product.introText: LACK side table 55x55x45 cm, white. Assembly instructions AA-2606170. Work on a soft surface (e.g. a rug) so the table top is not scratched. No tools needed. Max load 10 kg - do not sit on the table.

steps.title: Table top upside down
steps.text: Lay the table top upside down on a soft surface, such as a rug or the cardboard from the box, never directly on a hard floor (see the inset at the bottom of the page).

steps.title: Screw in the double-ended screws
steps.text: Turn the 4 double-ended screws (115980) by hand into the pre-drilled holes in the corners of the table top, until the collar in the middle of each screw reaches the surface.

steps.title: Screw on the legs
steps.text: Put each leg on a screw and turn the whole leg clockwise until it sits tight against the table top. Do not overtighten.

steps.title: Done - turn the table upright
steps.text: Turn the table the right way up. Max load 10 kg; do not sit or stand on it.
